answer: Because the ledge index resolves every citation against the wander checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 292 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 292 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 852 identities would post 3366 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
